en.title: Fewest Contiguous Segments with No Repeated Characters
en.description:
Cut a lowercase string into non-empty contiguous segments so that no character appears more than once within a segment; find the minimum number of segments. Characters cannot be reordered or skipped.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: One line containing the string. 1≤length≤100000, lowercase letters only.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 2, 4 and 2; abcabc can be split into abc and abc.
hints: Maintain the character set of the current segment; if the next character is a repeat, end the current segment and start a new one, otherwise add it.
